# Shared setup for the five decks + cheat sheet (labs carry their own inline copy so each lab stays a standalone script).
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(tidyverse); library(broom); library(gtsummary); library(sandwich); library(lmtest); library(performance); library(pscl) })
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 16))
dg_path <- c("data/dengue_wards.csv", "../data/dengue_wards.csv", "../../data/dengue_wards.csv")
dg_path <- dg_path[file.exists(dg_path)][1]
dg <- read_csv(dg_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |> mutate(slum = factor(slum, 0:1, c("Non-slum", "Slum")), fogging = factor(fogging, 0:1, c("No", "Yes")))
dg$ward <- factor(dg$ward)
col_blue <- "#3498db"; col_red <- "#e74c3c"; col_navy <- "#2c3e50"; col_green <- "#27ae60"

chunks.code: dg |> select(ward, date, population, slum, cases, rain_lag1, fogging) |> head(6)

c(cases = sum(dg$cases), rate_per_100k_person_months = round(sum(dg$cases) / sum(dg$population) * 1e5, 1))
dg |> group_by(slum) |> summarise(cases = sum(cases), person_months = sum(population), rate_per_100k = round(cases / person_months * 1e5, 1))

bind_rows(tibble(k = 0:25, p = dpois(0:25, 2), mu = "mean 2"), tibble(k = 0:25, p = dpois(0:25, 10), mu = "mean 10")) |>
  ggplot(aes(k, p, fill = mu)) + geom_col(position = "dodge") + labs(x = "Count", y = "Probability", fill = NULL)

c(mean = round(mean(dg$cases), 1), variance = round(var(dg$cases), 0))
c(observed_zeros = round(mean(dg$cases == 0), 3), poisson_expected_zeros = signif(dpois(0, mean(dg$cases)), 2))

dg |> group_by(date) |> summarise(cases = sum(cases)) |> ggplot(aes(date, cases)) + geom_line(colour = col_navy) + geom_point() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Cases in the city per month")
